title: Dependence of black carbon restructuring on the volatility of biomass burning organic aerosol coatings at the wildland–urban interface
content:

Fresh, higher-volatility biomass burning organic aerosol (BBOA) is more effective by volume than evaporatively aged, lower-volatility BBOA at inducing black carbon restructuring.
